text:
rachel: quick follow-up from last night's partial model loads. want a compact tracker that shows owners + explicit coverage windows and the recurrence estimate so rotations can be planned.
omar: agreed. PM observed auth vendor latency bursts roughly every 48-72h. treat as recurring transient until we either get vendor SLA changes or an internal durable fix.
kevin: here's what I see now: rollback script for bad manifests (kevin), local token cache + jittered TTL (omar), cross-region routing (ops). missing: automated circuit-breaker on model-loads and a concise alert classifier to cut down paged noise.
sre-bot: Postmortem filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RINF-4807 — summary: "external auth latency -> intermittent model-registry load failures". Severity: Sev3.
ops-bot: created action-row template in the tracker. link: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/vendor-dep-actions
kevin: propose tracker columns: primary | backup | backup_contact | coverage_window_UTC | rotation_cadence | observed_interval_days | automation_status. default cadence: infra weekly, oncall daily while we're in runway.
omar: detection metric suggestion: p95_auth_latency over 30m moving window; keep spike_count_24h. rule: if spike_count_24h >= 3 then page SRE + enable degraded-serving mode.
kevin: i'll own circuit-breaker + test harness. idea: when p95_auth_30m >= 1.2s for 3 samples, reduce model-load concurrency to 40% and prefer cache-first reads. will include dry-run routing tests. ETA: Wed.
omar: i'll implement /health/auth probe and a small webhook for the router. router marks provider unhealthy after 3 fails in 5m and flips to fallback. i'll also smooth token cache TTL with jitter. ETA: Thu EOD.
legal: we'll pull current contract and prepare suggested SLA language to request uptime/credit terms if this recurs.
rachel: action rollup — please ack in-thread: 1) kevin: circuit-breaker + test plan (ETA Wed) 2) omar: healthcheck + cache smoothing + router webhook (ETA Thu) 3) ops: add tracker columns and start daily digest to #incidents for 14 days (ops-bot) (ETA today) 4) legal: SLA capture (ETA Mon)
kevin: ack. will post PR link when ready.
omar: ack. will link probe PR.
ops-bot: scheduled: daily digest @09:30 to #incidents for 14 days.
sre-bot: note in KB: prefer degraded-serving (smaller batches + cache reads) over fail-open to avoid cascading retries. add runbook snippet for automation.
kevin: quick runbook snippet (short):
```yaml
trigger: auth_spike
conditions:
  - window: 30m
    p95_ms: ">=1200"
actions:
  - notify: #incidents
  - set_mode: degraded_serving
  - reduce_model_load_concurrency: 0.4
  - enable: token_cache
```
rachel: thanks — if owners need help meeting ETAs ping me. :thumbsup:
end of thread.
